chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid, may Allah be pleased with him, narrated to us, saying: Al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan Aban narrated to us, from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Ibn Sinan, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said: The Commander of the Believers (peace be upon him) said in his sermon:

I am the Guide, I am the Guided, and I am the father of the orphans and the needy, and the husband of the widows, and I am the refuge of every weak person, and the secure place of every fearful person, and I am the leader of the believers [into Paradise], and I am the Solid Rope of Allah, and I am the Strong Loop of Allah and the Word of Allah of Piety, and I am the Eye of Allah, and His Truthful Tongue, and His Hand, and I am the Regard of Allah, about which He says: «For a soul to say: How heartbroken am I for how undutiful I was towards the Regard of Allah» And I am the Hand of Allah that is extended towards His servants with mercy and forgiveness, and I am the Door of Humility. The one who knows me and knows my right, then he has known his Lord, because I am the Successor of His Prophet in His earth and His Proof upon His creation; none deny this except for one who rejects Allah and His Messenger.
ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual titles and roles of Imam Ali as described in his sermon?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Ma'ani al-Akhbar* highlights Imam Ali's multifaceted role as the 'Hujjah' (Proof) of God, emphasizing his function as the conduit for divine mercy and the ultimate authority in interpreting the Quran. The enumeration of titles such as 'Rope of Allah' and 'Eye of Allah' underscores the Shia doctrine of *Wilayah*, where the Imam serves as the tangible manifestation of God's attributes on earth. This sermon reinforces the necessity of recognizing the Imam's right (*Haqq*) as inseparable from the recognition of God Himself.
